meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 接入 Mattermost 作为机器人通道：收发私信、频道消息、线程、文件、表情和交互式审批卡片。它会先探测已有服务器和本地 Docker，再请你选择使用或创建评估服务器。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Mattermost 通道或机器人、把 Mattermost 接入 NanoClaw，或需要机器人处理 Mattermost 上的消息时触发。

say.note: 会先找本机或已有服务器，让你确认再用。

say.text: 添加一个 Mattermost 机器人，用于收发私信和频道。
say.note: 会创建机器人并配置回调。

say.text: 帮我搭一个本地测试 Mattermost 并连接。
say.note: 需要你批准后才会创建容器。

howto.what_en: Connects Claude to Mattermost as a bot for DMs, channels, threads, files, reactions, and approval cards. It probes for an existing Mattermost server and lets the user choose it, enter another URL, or create a local evaluation server.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Mattermost channel/bot or integrate Mattermost with NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Claude will detect a server or ask you to choose one.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost bot for DMs and channels.
say_en.note: It creates the bot and sets up callbacks.

say_en.text: Set up a local Mattermost test server and connect.
say_en.note: Requires your approval before creating containers.
